title.narrative: Regional Workshop on Curriculum Planning Framework and Networking within the "Transformation of Media Education and Science for the Development of Civil Society in Central Asia” initiative

description.narrative: A three-day workshop to be jointly organized by UNESCO Regional Office Almaty, Al-Farabi Kazakh National University and Asian Media Information and Communication Centre (AMIC) for key journalism education curriculum planners from the five Central Asian countries. For UNESCO Almaty this is an occasion for wider introduction of Media and Information Literacy, accessibility of media, responsible use of AI and other UNESCO principles of journalism education into the journalism curriculums in Central Asia.
